Part 1 高频 抽象 ABSTRACT

Music

音乐

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you prefer sad or happy music?

Definitely happy music, no question. Upbeat songs just lift my mood, especially when I'm feeling down or tired. Sad songs are nice once in a while, but they usually bring me down, which is why I skip them.

更喜欢欢快的歌，能立刻让我心情变好；伤感的歌听了容易低落，所以跳过。

Q2Does happy music make you feel more excited?

Yeah, it really does. When I listen to upbeat songs, my energy just goes up, and I feel much more motivated, even during dull tasks. I actually use happy music to get myself going before studying or exercising.

会，欢快的歌让我更有能量和动力，学习运动前都会先听来打气。

Q3待补充

I listen to music all the time, honestly. Mainly during my commute, while studying, and when I'm exercising, since upbeat songs keep me focused and energized. I'd say music is a big part of my daily routine.

通勤、学习和运动时都听，欢快的歌让我更专注更有劲，音乐是日常的一部分。
